profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a public company headquartered in New York, NY, trading under the ticker DDOG, with CIK 0001561550. Its website describes it as offering cloud monitoring as a service, letting users see metrics from their apps, tools, and services in one place, with a free trial available. The site also describes security and observability integration aimed at defending against AI-powered attacks, covering runtime execution, exposure in dynamic AI environments, and detection and response.

The site's material centers on cloud monitoring and security rather than named AI products. No products are tracked for the company, and no MCP servers are listed.

The company's recorded law exposure is in New York, with a count of 459. No cases are listed.
